concepts.name: Signal
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: alternative identity exploration for Mochi, a desktop companion that helps developers understand what they build with AI.
The human rejected generic cream-and-mint clay toy robots. This NEW direction must look like a distinctive, cool developer-tool brand with a small amount of playfulness. Design an original character and matching simplified app-icon study. It should feel deliberately designed, visually memorable and ownable, not stock AI mascot art. No cream-and-mint palette, no glossy oversized OLED robot face, no baby toy, no decorative glowing haze.
Wide landscape composition on a truly transparent background: large complete character on the left and one separate smaller rounded-square app-icon study on the right. Keep ample empty space between and around both. The icon must show a clean simplified version of this exact identity. No text, no lettering, no labels, no watermarks, no extra badges. Show all character parts. Neutral clean lighting where applicable. Alpha cutout edges must be crisp and clean with no halos. No broad shadow or background rectangle. The character will later gently float, wave and tilt, so expressive small hands or equivalent appendages are useful.
Direction A — SIGNAL ROBOT. Bold graphic 2D vector-like illustration with a tiny amount of flat cel shading; emphatically NOT 3D clay. An orange-red compact robot with an oversized rounded inverted-trapezoid head, two simple graphite dash eyes printed directly on its orange face (no inset screen), a short graphite pill torso, and small angular orange mitten arms and feet. A single clean off-center notch in the helmet silhouette gives it identity. Palette: coral orange #FF7048 dominant, ink graphite #171B24, neutral pure off-white #FAFAFA, no other colors. Restrained, witty and confident, not sugary. Slight three-quarter stance, one tiny hand up in greeting. The icon is a minimalist coral helmet silhouette and its two dark dash eyes against off-white; avoid tiny detail. Strong geometric edges with softened corners.

Direction B — MALLOW MOCHI CREATURE. Premium soft 3D rendered organic mochi spirit, smooth satin finish with controlled light, NOT a robot, NO display face, no metallic parts. A plump asymmetric pillow or soft lozenge silhouette, slightly wider than tall, pale periwinkle body #ADB7FF with deep plum #2F2143 simple expressive eyes directly on the skin and one small curved eyebrow. Tiny rounded hands integrated into the body, two very small soft feet. A subtle peach #FFAE93 lower-side patch gives the form a distinctive asymmetry. No ears, no antenna, no huge baby eyes, no smiley black screen. Slightly mischievous but gentle, a calm clever companion. Matching icon is the simple asymmetric periwinkle silhouette with plum eyes and a peach corner, on a deep-plum rounded square. Clean matte edges, no glow, no attached shadow.

Direction C — LOOP ABSTRACT MASCOT. Sculptural geometric 2.5D design, a living typographic shape without any letter. The entire body is one thick rounded cobalt-blue ribbon #3158F5 curling into an asymmetric open loop, like an original continuous bent arch with a visibly offset gap. A short orange #FF9248 ribbon tip extends sideways as a tiny waving appendage; the other end forms a small grounded-looking curled foot, but the character floats. Two tiny ivory square eyes are subtly inset in the upper blue curve; no separate head, no robot visor, no conventional humanoid body, no mochi blob. Crisp forms, subtle satin depth, clever visual tension and a confident developer-tool identity. The matching icon is the flattened cobalt open-loop glyph with orange terminal and two ivory eyes on a dark ink rounded square. Shape must be legible from silhouette alone. No busy highlights or bloom.
